El INGETRANS trabaja hoy al 22,4 % de s:

hourly peaks of up to 82,6 %. It can serve a second corrugator if the new demand does not coincide at
peak with the current one; a second corrugator of equal cadence and synchronised pace would take the car to saturation
in 10,0 % of hours and would require sequencing measures or a second car.

si se cumple una de estas condiciones:\:
if one of these conditions is met:
(a) the new corrugator has a cadence equal to or lower than half the current one; or (b) being of similar cadence, the
reel changes of both machines are sequenced from the MES so as not to coincide at peak, and P95 delivery times
higher than the current ones are accepted in 3–4 % of the hours. If the second corrugator is of equal cadence and the
sequence cannot be coordinated, the synchronised scenario saturates the transfer car 10 % of the hours and directly penalises the
availability of the corrugator: in that case a second transfer car is recommended (INGETRANS or INGETRANS Smart in the
corridor of the new machine).
Coordinar desde el MES las peticiones d: Coordinate the requests of the two corrugators in advance from the MES (staging) to avoid the coincidence of peaks; it is the measure with the greatest effect and the lowest cost.
Elevar del 5 % actual la proporción de: Raise from the current 5 % the proportion of trips that remove a partial reel and deliver the next one in the same cycle; it reduces missions and frees capacity for the second machine.
Analizar la asimetría de uso (7.304 fre: Analyse the usage asymmetry (7.304 against 5.077 events) to take advantage of double transport.
Confirmar por qué no recibe entregas au: Confirm why it does not receive automatic deliveries (55 in 90 days) and whether integrating it would increase the transfer car's demand.
Investigar los 65 estados congelados (1: Investigate the 65 frozen states (133 h) cross-checking with alarms and manual mode; define a task timeout and a cause code in the PLC.
Ejecutar el gemelo digital INGECART con: Run the INGECART digital twin with the real profile of the second corrugator (cadence, widths, schedules) over this log to fix the contractual delivery P95 before committing to the single-car solution.
Añadir al registro los tiempos de petic: Add to the log the request times (request-to-delivery), stop cause and battery/energy state according to the INGECART data-capture specification, to measure starvation directly.
